Platform Features

Everything You Need to Close Out a Project

From first check sheet to final turnover package, Arbiter covers every stage of the completions lifecycle.

SoftChecks

Digital check sheets, mobile and offline capable. Run inspections anywhere, no WiFi required.

Learn more

Actions & Deficiencies

Real-time punch list tracking and assignment. Every issue captured, assigned, and closed with a full audit trail.

Learn more

Real-Time Reporting

Earned vs. burned value, customizable dashboards. Your owners see what you see, with no progress guesswork.

Learn more

Dynamic ITP

Inspection and Test Plans with a full audit trail. ITPs that adapt to scope changes without losing traceability.

Learn more

Doculink

Document repository with batch upload of up to 500 files. Link drawings, specs, and certs directly to inspection records.

Learn more

Dossier (Document Turnover)

Digital turnover packages archived on client systems. Auto-compile the complete project record at handover, in minutes not weeks.

Our Differentiators

Built Different. Because the Field Demands It.

Generic project management software wasn't built for capital construction completions. Arbiter was. That difference shows up every day: in the field, at handover, and on the bottom line.

See Why Teams Choose Arbiter

Purpose-Built for Completions

Not a bolt-on module. Arbiter is designed ground-up for project completion and handover. Every feature exists because the field demanded it.

Built by the Field

15+ years of in-field refinement with multi-disciplinary input, from cable pullers to project leads. This is the software those people wish they had.

Offline & Mobile Capable

Works in remote locations without WiFi or cellular service. Sync when you reconnect and your data is never held hostage by a bad signal.

Proven Track Record

80–95% of Arbiter-managed projects completed on budget and on schedule. Over 300 projects across energy, oil sands, mining, and infrastructure.

Our Approach

Built for the Field, By the Field

Arbiter Completions has developed over a decade of in-field refinement with multi-disciplinary input and enhancement. Whether it's pulling cable, walkdowns, turnovers, construction or commissioning, Arbiter offers the consistency, control, and confidence Project Leaders are looking for.

Our platform was shaped by the people who use it: inspectors, QA/QC leads, project managers, and owners, so every workflow feels natural to the crews on the ground.
